accents.name: Vermilion
accents.usage: The default accent: a red leaning toward orange, the red of Swiss posters. Its values are the accent tokens below.

accents.name: Teal
accents.usage: Replaces the four accent tokens; every other token stays. Contrast: accent 3.5:1 on light paper and 4.9:1 on bar, accent-text 5.6:1 on paper, accent-bright 9.5:1 on bar, accent-ink 6.3:1 on accent-text and 3.9:1 on accent; dark 9.7:1 on paper, 8.5:1 on bar, 9.7:1 under accent-ink.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm cream in light, near-black in dark. Every text color below is checked against it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and the 2px thick rules on `paper` (17:1 light, 17:1 dark). Also the fill of a hovered or pressed outlined button.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, counts, sublines, row numbers on `paper` (5.0:1 light, 9.6:1 dark) and on `bar` in dark (8.4:1). On a filled row, switch to `row-fg`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Thin 1px row dividers on `paper`. Decorative only (1.4:1 light; dark is 40% of `ink` on `paper`, 3.5:1): never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand vermilion for LARGE shapes only: hero shapes, the primary action icon, tiles, the activity indicator, the 3px focus ring (3.9:1 on light `paper`, 5.9:1 dark). Never small text.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a vermilion fill (the filled button): 5.4:1 on light `accent-text`, 5.9:1 on dark.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Vermilion for small text on `paper` (4.8:1 light, 5.9:1 dark) and the fill of the filled button `.btn`.

tokens.name: accent-bright
tokens.usage: Vermilion for small text and marks on a dark `bar` surface: panel labels, current-page underline, toast edge (6.3:1 light, 5.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Dark surfaces that stay dark in both themes: the slide-down panel, the drawer, the top bar while either is open, a fixed bottom bar, the toast.

tokens.name: bar-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `bar` (17:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: row-hover-bg
tokens.usage: List row fill on hover. Black on cream in light; a raised dark in dark mode so the row never becomes a bright slab.

tokens.name: row-active-bg
tokens.usage: List row fill when the row is the active/current one.

tokens.name: row-fg
tokens.usage: All text on a filled row, muted text included (17:1 light, 16:1 dark).

tokens.name: row-edge
tokens.usage: 6px left edge of the active row. Invisible against the black fill in light; the accent in dark.

families.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero title, one per page. Fluid: clamp(4rem, 13vw, 10.5rem). Stack the name on two lines when large.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title under a 2px `ink` rule. 2.25rem below 768px, 3rem from 768px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A list item's name. Slightly open tracking. 1.25rem below 768px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Flat color, thick rules, one typeface.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under the hero. 1.125rem below 768px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Type does the work. Nothing is decorative.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Sublines, meta and counts. 14px is the floor for any text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small UPPERCASE label, one or two words only. Longer labels use sentence case (`.prose-sentence`).

styles.name: menu-item
styles.usage: Top-level item in the slide-down panel. 1.75rem below 768px.

styles.name: submenu-item
styles.usage: Sub-items and nested accordion headings in the panel.

styles.name: field-input
styles.usage: Text typed into an underline-only field.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a field label and its field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group and between grid columns.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Top bar vertical padding; padding under a section's thick rule.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding; row number inset from the left edge; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its rows; form padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Side gutter from 640px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero padding from 768px.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Content width, centered (`.page`, `.panel-inner`).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding. Becomes 2rem from 640px (set in bundle.css).

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Height of a fixed bottom bar. The panel and toast stop above it. Set to 0rem when the site has no bottom bar.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, fields, rows, panels, cards. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Six small marks only: the loading spinner, the "new" dot, the drawer's "more below" arrow, the radio button, and at 50% the oval badge and the number circle.
